content:
We boys are thinking about selling a kidney to buy an iPhone… 😂

And girls are getting iPhones for FREE 😭🤨

Wow… life really has its own rules. 🤣
Why is there always injustice with boys? 😭😂

A viral news on social media says that a businessman in Chandigarh is organising an “iPhone Langar”, where free iPhones are reportedly being offered to women aged 18 and above.

When I first heard about the iPhone Langar, I thought:

“Ab aayega na maza, bhidu ” 😍😂

But then I found out the offer is only for women.

There goes my iPhone. Again. 😭🤣

Now I’m also wondering…

Is this actually true, or will we end up giving away our personal data instead of getting an iPhone? 😂

Kahin ye Anuradha ka bhai toh nahi…
“21 din mein paisa double” 🤣🤣

Anyway, Chandigarh people, you try your luck 😂

If you actually get an iPhone, please let us know.

I just want to know whether I missed an iPhone…
or successfully avoided a scam. 😅🤣


~ Mohd Intzar Ali
comment: Beyond the humour, these viral offers are a good reminder to verify the source, terms and data permissions first. Free products often come with hidden costs around privacy and trust.
